inferences.claim: The finale stand held the replica and the original was later found in Repair Case 2.

evidence.summary: IC03 replica on stand, serial plate absent
evidence.verify_sql: select check_id from sql02_inventory_checks where check_id = 'IC03' and item_id = 'MASK-REPL'
select check_id from sql02_inventory_checks where check_id = 'IC05' and location = 'REPAIR_CASE-2'

inferences.claim: Dev held the prop custody duty.

evidence.verify_sql: select assignment_id from sql02_role_assignments where assignment_id = 'RA01' and character_id = 'DEV'

inferences.claim: Nikhil was onstage before the original returned to the prop bay.

evidence.verify_sql: select event_id from sql02_access_events where event_id = 'AC03' and assigned_character_id = 'NIK' and note ilike '%onstage from 18:55%'
select movement_id from sql02_prop_movements where movement_id = 'PM04' and to_location = 'PROP_BAY'

inferences.claim: The replica replaced the original between 18:57 and 19:08.

evidence.summary: PM05 replica to stage-left wing at 18:59
evidence.verify_sql: select movement_id from sql02_prop_movements where movement_id = 'PM05' and item_id = 'MASK-REPL' and handled_by = 'DEV'

evidence.summary: IC03 replica on display stand at 19:08
evidence.verify_sql: select check_id from sql02_inventory_checks where check_id = 'IC03' and location = 'DISPLAY_STAND'

inferences.claim: The cue log shows the wrong item but no prop handling by Kavya.

evidence.verify_sql: select cue_event_id from sql02_cue_log where cue_event_id = 'CU02' and operator_id = 'KAV' and observed_item_id = 'MASK-REPL'

evidence.summary: AC06 AV booth credential, not prop bay
evidence.verify_sql: select event_id from sql02_access_events where event_id = 'AC06' and zone = 'AV_BOOTH'

inferences.claim: Dev concealed the move and admitted it afterwards.

evidence.summary: MSG03 do not update the producer
evidence.verify_sql: select message_id from sql02_messages where message_id = 'MSG03' and sender_id = 'DEV' and body ilike '%producer%'
select message_id from sql02_messages where message_id = 'MSG06' and body ilike '%Repair Case 2%'
select movement_id from sql02_prop_movements where movement_id = 'PM07' and to_location = 'REPAIR_CASE-2'

red_herrings.why_suspicious: He argued against using the mask and was seen at the stage-left door.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: His credential exited toward the stage at 18:54 and the call sheet puts him onstage from 18:55, before the original returned to the prop bay at 18:57. He has no movement of either mask.

evidence.verify_sql: select event_id from sql02_access_events where event_id = 'AC03' and note ilike '%onstage%'

red_herrings.why_suspicious: She triggered the cue that played with the wrong item.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: The cue log shows she followed the run sheet; her role and credentials are the AV booth and nothing places her in the prop bay.

evidence.verify_sql: select cue_event_id from sql02_cue_log where cue_event_id = 'CU02' and note ilike '%run sheet%'
select event_id from sql02_access_events where event_id = 'AC06' and note ilike '%not a prop-bay credential%'

red_herrings.why_suspicious: He opened the staff door during the swap window.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: The delivery manifest lists fabric rolls only, and no mask movement is assigned to him.

evidence.verify_sql: select event_id from sql02_access_events where event_id = 'AC09' and note ilike '%fabric rolls%'
